_comment: Operating budget and Trustee Confidence (§3, §8), Phase 1 checkpoint 1i. Amounts in an era's eras.* section are in THAT era's dollars (not modern x multiplier); building upkeep comes from the building definitions (modern dollars x the era's price_multiplier). Every amount is a [TWEAK] placeholder; the 1820s figures are not researched yet.
_eras_comment: Per era id (eras.json); 'default' covers eras not listed. Tuition and room rent are per student per year, charged half each term (move-in and spring_term_start). Land rents: Miami's income from leasing its township land [VERIFY amounts]. State support per year.

founding._fees_comment: Upham, Old Miami (1909): tuition $10 a session (two sessions a year assumed [VERIFY]), room and servant hire $5 a year. Land rents, salaries and administration are still placeholders: the rent ledgers are in the University Archives.

_default_upkeep_comment: Yearly upkeep in modern dollars for real buildings with no building definition, by kind (x the era's price_multiplier).

tuition._comment: The player sets tuition as a multiple of the era's base rate. Applicants change by 1 - elasticity x (level - 1) (§8.4: out-of-state demand is elastic).

trustees._comment: §3: Confidence 0-100, starts at balance.json trustees.starting_confidence. Reviewed once a year at the fiscal year end; 0 = dismissed.
